question: Which type of cell lacks a membrane-bound nucleus?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prokaryotic cell**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prokaryotic cells** are simple, single-celled organisms that lack a membrane-bound nucleus.
 
• These cells have a single circular chromosome that is located in a region called the **nucleoid**.
 
• Prokaryotes include organisms such as **bacteria** and **archaea**.
 
• They have other structures such as **ribosomes**, but these are not membrane-bound.
 
• The cell membrane of prokaryotes is surrounded by a **cell wall**, which provides structure and protection.
 
• Prokaryotic cells reproduce asexually through a process called **binary fission**.
 
• They are generally smaller in size compared to eukaryotic cells.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Eukaryotic cell**__

 __
 
• **Eukaryotic cells** have a membrane-bound nucleus that contains their genetic material.
 
• These cells are found in organisms such as **plants, animals, fungi, and protists**.
 
• Eukaryotic cells also have various other membrane-bound organelles, like the **mitochondria** and **endoplasmic reticulum**.
 
 
 
• **Animal cell**__
 __
 
• **Animal cells** are a type of eukaryotic cell that lacks a cell wall.
 
• These cells contain various organelles, including a **nucleus, mitochondria, and lysosomes**.
 
 
 
• **Plant cell**__
 
 
• **Plant cells** are another type of eukaryotic cell that have a **cell wall** made of cellulose.
 
• They also contain **chloroplasts**, which are involved in photosynthesis.
